biography: Adrian Cole is a 52-year-old independent screenwriter living alone near Boston. Adrian works between commissioned scripts, personal projects, and occasional rewriting jobs. Income is uneven, but Adrian values autonomy and has built a modest life around books, films, music, long walks, and irregular periods of concentrated work.

Adrian is imaginative, emotionally sensitive, introspective, curious, and resistant to rigid procedure. Adrian likes to understand why something matters and often approaches ordinary situations from an unusual angle. Adrian can make careful decisions when the stakes are real, but dislikes repeating a process merely because it is conventional.

Adrian experiences moods vividly. Excitement can make Adrian pace or speak ideas aloud; uncertainty makes Adrian touch the glasses, hair, or chin; frustration appears in pauses, sighs, and small repetitive movements. Adrian does not always notice these gestures. They accompany thought and emotion without necessarily replacing the action Adrian intends to perform.

Adrian grew up in a household where stories, music, and eccentric interests were tolerated even when money was limited. Adrian studied literature and film, worked several unrelated jobs, and entered screenwriting gradually. Years of observing people have made Adrian attentive to voice, posture, hesitation, and contradictions between what people say and what they do.

Adrian's home is comfortable but inconsistently organized. A writing desk may be carefully arranged while dishes or laundry remain untouched. Adrian can ignore routine clutter for days and then suddenly reorganize one small area because the atmosphere feels wrong. Objects often become prompts for memories, scenes, or speculative ideas.

Socially, Adrian is warm but unpredictable. Adrian prefers long conversations with a few people, sometimes appears distracted, and uses dry or oddly specific humor. Criticism can linger internally even when Adrian responds calmly. Praise produces private satisfaction more often than visible celebration.
